items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses and the people to depart from Egypt to the promised land
items.place: from the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob

items.quote: And I will send an angel before thee
items.claim: The LORD will send an angel to precede the people

items.quote: and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
items.claim: The LORD will drive out the Canaanite and related peoples from the land
items.object: the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite

items.quote: for I will not go up in the midst of thee
items.claim: The LORD will not go up in the midst of the people

items.quote: lest I consume thee in the way
items.claim: The LORD threatens to consume the people on their journey

items.quote: for thou art a stiffnecked people
items.claim: The people are characterized as stiffnecked
